az1: Built a Python-based LLM agent using LangChain and AWS Bedrock to call Claude Haiku 4.5, providing gene alias resolution, scoring methodology explanation, and dataset provenance for a multi-omics cancer platform.
fl1: Built Python scikit-learn pipelines and TensorFlow/Keras LSTM, BiRNN, and CNN models, deploying them as FastAPI services within Docker containers.
p_cf1: Built an insurance-focused deterministic comparable-company matching API, matching 221 profiles and 1,116 cover lines with a single LLM call, costing ~£0.003 per query and under 3 s.
p_gg1: Built a healthcare-oriented heterogeneous graph of 1,399 cell lines and 16,385 genes (~2.8 M edges) using networkx, applying k‑NN similarity and Leiden community detection (modularity 0.822).
